note:
this lane can run, and why it is not the assignment's.**  `r11` exists
only on the three fold panels -- each panel is one validation month with an
out-of-fold v11 -- so a "fit on the 2025 months other than the scored fold" needs the
block on those months, and the harvest is delivering 2025-07, 2025-12, 2026-01 and
2026-07, not 2025-01.  So the rotation is the two-panel one `exp-046-surfacefit`
recorded as a deviation for the same reason: fit on december and score july_loo, fit on
july_loo and score december.  **January cannot be scored**, so the assignment's
"every fold interval clear of zero" clause is evaluated on two folds of three and the
gap is named in the record rather than papered over.
